EchoColony.XenotypeAIPromptDef.promptDescription: A towering, colossal giant engineered with immense physical strength and durability, built to endure harsh frontier worlds and wield massive weaponry.
A frost-born titan of colossal height and pale, icy skin, biologically adapted to thrive in extreme sub-zero blizzards with crushing physical might.
A volcanic fire-giant of colossal stature, completely immune to scorching heat and blazing temperatures, possessing immense physical strength.
An ancient archite-ascended fire titan, embodying primordial flame, apocalyptic heat, and near-invulnerable physical might.
An ancient archite-ascended frost progenitor titan, radiating glacial cold and possessing monumental physical stature and regenerative vitality.
A hybrid giant standing noticeably taller and heavier than baseline humans, inheriting substantial jotun strength and resilience without reaching full titan proportions.
A hulking, brutish giant with a heavy frame, dull wits, and tremendous crude muscle power, built for manual labor and brutal melee combat.
A massive, primeval ogre titan of immense size and terrifying brute strength, possessing primitive cunning and formidable durability.
An incomplete, vat-grown titan whose cellular structure suffers from chronic genetic deterioration and unstable metabolic decay.
A nightmarish, nanotechnologically corrupted titan whose berserk xenogenes and rogue archites have mutated into a violently insane living bioweapon.
A young troll of heavy, monstrous build and rough hide, possessing rapid biological cellular regeneration that visibly mends wounds and knits torn flesh.
A hulking adult troll with gnarled skin, brutish features, and astonishing biological regeneration that continuously knits flesh and mends scars.
An ancient, colossal troll whose petrified, mossy bark-like hide resembles living stone and wood, possessing near-indestructible regenerative vitality.
A stout, compact dwarven subterranean humanoid, remarkably dense and physically sturdy for their small frame, gifted with acute dark-vision and natural affinity for craftsmanship and mining.
A diminutive, nimble humanoid folk of miniature stature and spirited personality, quick on their feet and thriving in tight domestic quarters.
A shadowy, subterranean dvergr offshoot adapted to lightless cavern depths, possessing a secretive demeanor and resilient subterranean constitution.
A sinister, predatory goblinoid folk driven by a thirst for blood, swift in ambushes and possessing feral combat ferocity.
A compact biomechanical warmech construct forged in dvergr workshops, designed to encase and protect a small pilot in frontline combat.
A miniature biomechanical shell built by dvergr to allow smaller kin to operate at baseline human proportions.
A grotesque, hollowed-out flesh golem engineered through arcane alchemy, animated only when piloted by a diminutive creature from within.
An obedient, mindless homunculus crafted from stitched muscle and synthetic sinew to perform heavy brute labor.
